correctness.rationale: For the central plane O∩(q,t,1)^perp with 0<=q<=t<=1, independently checked its six edge-intersection polygon vertices, area B(q,t) and diameter D(q)=2sqrt(1+q²)/(1+q). Exact symbolic differentiation of B(q,t)^2 equals a negative positive-factor multiple of P_q(t), where P_q is concave with P_q(q)=3q(1-q)>0 and P_q(1)=-3q²(1-q)<0. Therefore for 0<q<1 its unique positive root T(q) lies strictly inside (q,1), and B is decreasing then increasing. The endpoint gap B(q,q)^2-B(q,1)^2=2(1-q)^3/(1+q)^3>0 proves unique maximum at t=q. Continuity supplies every intermediate area. The q=0,1 degenerate sections yield D=2 with area [sqrt2,2] and D=sqrt2 with A=3sqrt3/4; inversion of D checked. Symbolic identities and independent numerical polygon checks corroborated exact analysis; no finite sample substitutes for continuum sign proof.
